body:
﻿## Reproduction
At 1920×1080, arm square Build or a room template, leave the pointer stationary over the map, then turn/tilt/zoom the angled camera using the keyboard or HUD. The preview remains attached to the old world square while the next click is picked from the new camera pose. A mirrored four-cell row can appear under the cursor but place at another origin.

## Observed evidence
- Square Build browser harness: hover at (1100,580), yaw 0°/elevation 45° targets tile (5,4). Change the pose to yaw 37°/elevation 25° without moving the pointer. Before the scene fix, preview still targets (5,4), while the click should target (6,3). A production mutation removing preview repaint reproduced the mismatch; the corrected Full HD test passes.
- Room plan bridge: stationary-cursor mirrored row reproduced a ghost polygon that did not contain the cursor after KeyE; the bridge test was red with old x=25 versus expected x=29. Its separate patch recalculates the pick on camera change.

## Acceptance
- Hover previews for ordinary square Build and room plans reproject from the current screen pointer whenever the camera pose changes, even without a mousemove.
- A click at that pointer commits the same square/origin shown in the preview; construction footprint and costs do not change.
- Validate at intermediate angles, all four drag directions, and map edges in Full HD. Keep keyboard/HUD/mouse camera controls working.

## Implementation checkpoints
- Square Build scene and Full HD tests: `cca1705343` on `codex/oblique-angle-build-qa-20261001` (2/2 browser green; test red under preview-repaint mutation).
- Room-template bridge: `c0ac4b751f` on `codex/room-row-camera-qa-20261001` (stationary-cursor mirrored-row browser proof; further test checkpoint pending).

Related scope: #1585 and #1586. This is a distinct camera-pose synchronization defect, not the asynchronous reply race in #1606.

comments.body:
﻿Additional held-drag case at 1920×1080: while LMB remained down, keyboard zoom changed the angled camera and the minimap viewport. The Build ghost/HUD still previewed 6 whole squares; moving the mouse only 1 px changed it to 5, and release sent 5 actual `PlaceBuildOrder` commands. This is the active-gesture counterpart of the stationary hover defect described above.

Fix and durable browser evidence: branch `codex/oblique-held-gesture-camera-20261002`, commit `a3b0685fbd`, `docs/research/2026-10-02-held-build-camera-preview/README.md`. Real production test baseline red, source green, removing the endpoint reprojection red again, restored green. The pressed world square stays fixed; the held endpoint follows the current camera projection of the stationary screen cursor. Parent integration remains pending.

title: Angled Build and room-plan ghosts stay on old tile after camera turn
